knowledge_domain: EPA & USGS Hydro-Ecological Expert Decision Rules
disclaimer: The system provides AI-assisted decision support and risk indicators, not forensic proof.

HYPOXIA.name: Severe Hypoxia & Dissolved Oxygen Depletion
root_causes: Possible elevated microbial biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) from organic decay.
Potential thermal stratification restricting atmospheric re-aeration.
Possible post-bloom algal respiration collapse and biological oxygen uptake.

immediate: Deploy emergency mechanical aeration diffusers in affected river reaches / water body.
Issue immediate advisory to local aquaculture and fisheries authorities.
Restrict industrial and wastewater thermal effluent discharges.
short_term: Increase continuous multiparameter sonde telemetry sampling frequency to 5-minute intervals.
Conduct upstream tributary spatial transect sampling to investigate organic load sources.
long_term: Establish riparian vegetative buffer zones to mitigate thermal warming.
Implement catchment-wide Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) restrictions on organic discharge.

EUTROPHICATION.name: Eutrophication & Nutrient Hyper-Enrichment Risk
root_causes: Possible agricultural synthetic fertilizer runoff (elevated nitrates or orthophosphates).
Potential municipal wastewater overflow or septic system infiltration.
Possible internal benthic sediment phosphorus release under warm, low-oxygen conditions.

immediate: Isolate raw municipal drinking water intakes to prevent cyanotoxin ingress.
Collect laboratory grab samples for microcystin and cyanobacteria cell density screening.
Activate chemical dosing pre-treatment (flocculation / PAC) if intake remains open.
short_term: Inspect agricultural drainage outlets and storm runoff channels within 5 km upstream.
Deploy drone / satellite remote sensing to track algal bloom chlorophyll-a spatial extent.
long_term: Mandate precision nutrient management and cover crop adoption across upstream farms.
Upgrade regional municipal wastewater treatment plants to advanced biological nutrient removal (BNR).

SEDIMENT_CONTAMINATION.name: Sediment Shock & Particulate Loading
root_causes: Storm-driven overland soil erosion or high-energy surface runoff.
Possible construction clearing or riparian disturbance without adequate silt containment.
Potential upstream riverbank collapse or channel scouring activities.

immediate: Activate coagulant and flocculant dosing at drinking water treatment filtration units.
Temporarily bypass water supply reservoir raw intakes if sediment load exceeds plant capacity.
Issue river navigation / dredging advisory due to severe light attenuation.
short_term: Inspect active civil engineering and construction sites along riverbanks for silt containment compliance.
Monitor river downstream sedimentation zones for potential benthic habitat smothering.
long_term: Construct catchment sediment retention basins and bio-retention swales.
Implement bio-engineered streambank stabilization and native revegetation programs.

ACIDIFICATION.name: Severe Acidification / Chemical Influx Risk
root_causes: Possible unauthorized industrial acid discharge or chemical waste influx.
Potential Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) containing dissolved sulfide mineral oxidation products.
Potential localized acidic runoff over poorly-buffered catchment geology.

immediate: TRIGGER IMMEDIATE WATER INTAKE SHUTDOWN: Do not draw raw water into distribution network.
Dispatch HazMat environmental enforcement team with lime / alkaline neutralizing agents.
Notify downstream municipalities and public health agencies of potential chemical plume.
short_term: Conduct trace metal screening (pH < 4.5 leaches aluminum, lead, and zinc into ionic solution).
Trace pipeline networks and industrial stormwater outfalls using conductance triangulation.
long_term: Construct passive limestone neutralization drains and constructed wetlands for mine drainages.
Enforce zero liquid discharge (ZLD) regulations and continuous pH gate locks on industrial outfalls.

ALKALINE_SPILL.name: Caustic Influx / Severe Alkalinization Risk
root_causes: Possible caustic soda (NaOH) industrial wash-down or chemical manufacturing effluent.
Potential concrete washout runoff from active construction or bridge work.
Possible alkaline agricultural or industrial soil amendment runoff.

immediate: Close drinking water intake sluices to prevent caustic damage to filtration membranes.
Deploy carbon dioxide bubbling / acid dosing containment if isolated in retention impoundment.
short_term: Inspect all concrete mixing and construction outfalls within 10 km upstream.
long_term: Install automated pH cutoff valves at all industrial concrete manufacturing facilities.

TOXIC_CONTAMINATION.name: Toxic Contamination Risk (Inferred from Proxies)
root_causes: Possible electroplating, tannery, or metallurgical industrial discharge inferred from proxy indicators.
Potential legacy mining tailings seepage or hazardous waste leachate.
Possible corrosive distribution infrastructure leaching into source tributary.

immediate: MANDATORY WATER UTILITY SHUTDOWN: Cease all drinking water extraction immediately.
Issue public boil-water / alternative drinking water supply emergency notice.
Deploy mobile Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) mobile lab.
short_term: Execute upstream industrial audit and trace metal mass balance modeling.
Perform acute bioassay toxicity testing with Ceriodaphnia dubia and Hyalella azteca.
long_term: Install granular activated carbon (GAC) and ion-exchange polishing at municipal intake plants.
Implement strict industrial wastewater pretreatment compliance under EPA Clean Water Act.

THERMAL_STRESS.name: Elevated Thermal Stress & Heat Pollution
root_causes: Possible thermoelectric power plant or industrial cooling water discharge.
Potential meteorological heat wave combined with reduced riparian canopy shade.
Low stream baseflow with high solar irradiance.

immediate: Request power plant cooling discharge curtailment or cooling tower recirculation.
Increase upstream dam cold-water hypolimnetic reservoir release if available.
short_term: Monitor cold-water stenothermal fish species (trout, salmon) for thermal stress avoidance behavior.
long_term: Reforest riparian buffer strips to provide natural stream canopy shade.

ECOSYSTEM_COLLAPSE.name: Biological Ecosystem Health Collapse
root_causes: Possible multi-pollutant cumulative stress exceeding biological carrying capacity.
Potential acute ecotoxicity indicated by bioassay organism mortality.
Severe structural loss of macroinvertebrate biodiversity and trophic imbalance.

immediate: Declare river reach as ecologically degraded under biological criteria provisions.
Conduct emergency toxicity identification evaluation (TIE) to isolate offending chemical agents.
short_term: Perform comprehensive benthic macroinvertebrate multi-metric bioassessment (EPT index).
long_term: Establish multi-year ecological catchment restoration and habitat rehabilitation masterplan.

NOMINAL_BASELINE.name: Pristine Baseline / Nominal Water Quality
root_causes: Stable hydrological baseflow with balanced ecological and chemical indicators.

immediate: Maintain standard operational drinking water intake protocol.
Continue routine automated 15-minute telemetry streaming.
short_term: Log verified baseline values to catchment seasonal reference database.
long_term: Maintain watershed conservation and anti-degradation management practices.
